table.retrieve:
select 
	Status=0,
	V.documentcode, 
	type = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
	date = V.date, 
	debit = V.Debit,
	credit= V.Credit,
	remark = V.Remarks,
	c.name,
	cash = case ISNULL(v.AlternateAccCode, -1) when -1 then 'N' else 'Y' end,
	c.aliasname,
	openbalance=(select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate),
	openbalanceFC=ISNULL((select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate), 0) / CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.Date <= :ar_startdate) > 0 THEN (SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.Date <= :ar_startdate) ELSE 1 END,
	V.CheckNo,
	V.VRow,
	V.vouchercode,
	PendingCheque=0,
	GRN = V.GRN,
	Vehicle = V.Vehicle,
	Agency = (SELECT GC.Name FROM GoodsCompany GC WHERE GC.GCCode = V.GCCode),
	ShipTo = V.ShipTo,
	Freight = CASE WHEN V.documenttype = 'SV' AND V.Debit > 0 THEN (SELECT S.FlatDisc FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.SaleInvCode = V.DocumentCode) ELSE 0 END,
	CurrencyCode=V.CurrencyCode,
	ConversionRate=ISNULL(V.ConversionRate, (SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.Date <= V.Date))
from     
	VirtualGL V,
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name
	FROM	accounts a
	WHERE	a.acccode IN (:ar_acccode)) C
where   (V.AccCode = C.AccCode OR V.AlternateAccCode = C.AccCode ) and
	V.date     >= :ar_startdate and
	V.date     <= :ar_enddate
union all
select	
	Status=0,
	V.documentcode, 
	type = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
	date = V.date, 
	debit = V.Credit,
	credit= V.Debit,
	remark = Case debit 
			When 0 then 'Cash Paid Against Sale Ret. # '
			Else 'Cash Received Against Sales Inv. # '
			End + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))),
	c.name,
	cash = case ISNULL(v.AlternateAccCode, -1) when -1 then 'N' else 'Y' end,
	c.aliasname,
	openbalance=(select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate),
	openbalanceFC=ISNULL((select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate), 0) / CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.Date <= :ar_startdate) > 0 THEN (SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.Date <= :ar_startdate) ELSE 1 END,
	V.CheckNo,
	V.VRow,
	V.vouchercode,
	PendingCheque=0,
	GRN = V.GRN,
	Vehicle = V.Vehicle,
	Agency = (SELECT GC.Name FROM GoodsCompany GC WHERE GC.GCCode = V.GCCode),
	ShipTo = V.ShipTo,
	Freight = 0,
	CurrencyCode=V.CurrencyCode,
	ConversionRate=ISNULL(V.ConversionRate, (SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.Date <= V.Date))
from     VirtualGL V,
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name
	FROM	accounts a
	WHERE	a.acccode IN (:ar_acccode)) C
where   (V.AlternateAccCode = C.AccCode ) and
	V.date     >= :ar_startdate and
	V.date     <= :ar_enddate
UNION ALL
select
	Status=0,
	documentcode = N.NoteCode, 
	Type = Case N.NoteCatCode When 1 Then '*NR' Else '*NP' End + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), N.NoteCode))),  
	date = N.duedate, 
	debit = Case N.NoteCatCode When 1 Then CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN 0 ELSE N.Amount END ELSE CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN N.Amount ELSE 0 END END,
	credit= Case N.NoteCatCode When 1 Then CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN N.Amount ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN 0 ELSE N.Amount END END,
	remark = N.Remarks,
	c.name,
	cash = 'N',
	c.aliasname,
	openbalance=(select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate),
	openbalanceFC=ISNULL((select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate), 0) / CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.Date <= :ar_startdate) > 0 THEN (SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.Date <= :ar_startdate) ELSE 1 END,
	CheckNo = LEFT(N.DocumentNumber, 20),
	VRow=999999,
	N.vouchercode,
	PendingCheque=1,
	GRN = NULL,
	Vehicle = NULL,
	Agency = NULL,
	ShipTo = NULL,
	Freight = 0,
	CurrencyCode=NULL,
	ConversionRate=(SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.Date <= N.DueDate)
from 
	Notes N,
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name
	FROM	accounts a
	WHERE	a.acccode IN (:ar_acccode)) C
where   
	(N.AccCode = C.AccCode OR N.BankAccCode = C.AccCode ) and
	N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized = 'Y'
UNION ALL
select
	Status=0,
	documentcode=NULL, 
	type = NULL, 
	date = :ar_enddate, 
	debit = 0,
	credit= 0,
	remark = 'OPENING BALANCE',
	c.name,
	cash = 'N',
	c.aliasname,
	openbalance=ISNULL((select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate), 0),
	openbalanceFC=ISNULL((select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate), 0) / CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.ConversionRate <> 1 AND VV.Date <= :ar_startdate) > 0 THEN (SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.ConversionRate <> 1 AND VV.Date <= :ar_startdate) ELSE 1 END,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=0,
	vouchercode=NULL,
	PendingCheque=0,
	GRN = NULL,
	Vehicle = NULL,
	Agency = NULL,
	ShipTo = NULL,
	Freight = 0,
	CurrencyCode=NULL,
	ConversionRate=(SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.Date <= :ar_startdate)
from
   (SELECT a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name
	FROM	accounts a
	WHERE	a.acccode IN (:ar_acccode) and 
			a.acccode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT VGL.AccCode 
			FROM VirtualGL VGL 
			WHERE VGL.Date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND 
				VGL.AccCode IN (:ar_acccode)
			UNION ALL
			SELECT DISTINCT N.AccCode 
			FROM Notes N
			WHERE N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized='Y' AND
				N.AccCode IN (:ar_acccode)
			UNION ALL
			SELECT DISTINCT N.BankAccCode 
			FROM Notes N
			WHERE N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized='Y' AND
				N.AccCode IN (:ar_acccode)) ) C
UNION ALL
select
	Status=1,
	documentcode=V.documentcode, 
	type = '*' + V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))),
	date = V.Date, 
	debit = V.Debit,
	credit= V.Credit,
	remark = V.Remarks,
	A.name,
	cash = 'N',
	A.aliasname,
	openbalance=ISNULL((select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=A.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate), 0),
	openbalanceFC=ISNULL((select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=A.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate), 0) / CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.ConversionRate <> 1 AND VV.Date <= :ar_startdate) > 0 THEN (SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.ConversionRate <> 1 AND VV.Date <= :ar_startdate) ELSE 1 END,
	CheckNo=V.CheckNo,
	VRow=V.VRow,
	vouchercode=V.vouchercode,
	PendingCheque=0,
	GRN = V.GRN,
	Vehicle = V.Vehicle,
	Agency = (SELECT GC.Name FROM GoodsCompany GC WHERE GC.GCCode = V.GCCode),
	ShipTo = V.ShipTo,
	Freight = CASE WHEN V.documenttype = 'SV' AND V.Debit > 0 THEN (SELECT S.FlatDisc FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.SaleInvCode = V.DocumentCode) ELSE 0 END,
	CurrencyCode=V.CurrencyCode,
	ConversionRate=ISNULL(V.ConversionRate, (SELECT MAX(VV.ConversionRate) FROM VirtualGL VV WHERE VV.Date <= V.Date))
FROM 
	(SELECT * FROM Dbo.Fn_GetUnposted_AccTrans()) AS V, 
	Accounts A, SubAccounts S
WHERE
	V.AccCode IN (:ar_acccode) and
	V.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
	A.SubCode = S.SubAccCode
order by name, aliasname, status, date, type, VRow

objects.expression: IF(openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ) > 0, 'Dr', IF(openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ) < 0, 'Cr', ''))

objects.name: c_runingbalance

objects.name: compute_8
objects.expression: debit / if( isnull(conversionrate), 1,  conversionrate )

objects.name: compute_10
objects.expression: credit / if( isnull(conversionrate), 1,  conversionrate )

objects.name: compute_12
objects.expression: IF(openbalancefc  + cumulativeSum((debit / if(conversionrate > 0, conversionrate, 1))  - ( credit / if(conversionrate > 0, conversionrate, 1))  for group 1) > 0, 'Dr', if(openbalancefc  + cumulativeSum((debit / if(conversionrate > 0, conversionrate, 1))  - ( credit / if(conversionrate > 0, conversionrate, 1))  for group 1) < 0, 'Cr', ''))

objects.name: compute_11
objects.expression: abs(  openbalancefc  + cumulativeSum((debit / if(conversionrate > 0, conversionrate, 1))  - ( credit / if(conversionrate > 0, conversionrate, 1))  for group 1))

objects.name: c_openbalance

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: IF(openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ) - debit + credit > 0, 'Dr', IF(openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ) - debit + credit < 0, 'Cr', ''))

objects.name: compute_16

objects.name: compute_15
objects.expression: abs(  openbalancefc  + cumulativeSum((debit / if(conversionrate > 0, conversionrate, 1))  - ( credit / if(conversionrate > 0, conversionrate, 1))  for group 1) - (debit / if(conversionrate > 0, conversionrate, 1)) + (credit / if(conversionrate > 0, conversionrate, 1) ))
